# Create Save converts enabled fields and retains the draft

For D332899 at revision 3e22f6ce2506a323aecd485c174f9dab1c3a0298, the AI assessment describes the field conversion loop as copying enabled-field values into a new Calendar event, excluding disabled fields, and retaining the draft for retry. This contract is useful when changing conversion or its comments. The AI reports passing conversion, disabled-row exclusion, and retention tests; this is reported evidence rather than independent verification. The proposed explanatory comment was not accepted.

Scope: Calendar event create Save conversion.
